name: Мелкие обломки — тройной кластер
subject: ONE destructible natural gray rock resource asset, angular stepped fused voxel geology, warm-gray primary stone with a few pale coarse mineral patches, dark-gray wide fracture seams and restrained FLAT olive moss color patches attached to stone surfaces (no growing plants). Large Minecraft-style cubic masses with chunky material pixels, no tiny rubble confetti, smooth beveled stone or photoreal texture. No soil, ground, grass, pedestal or landscape. This is ONE variant, not a family gallery or destruction sequence. All five copies show the same arrangement of main masses, cracks and separate fragments. Fourth destruction-stage SMALL rubble. THREE unequal low separate broken stone chunks arranged in a compact triangular grouping, one small chip between them. Clearly small low fragments, no intact central monolith and no enclosing soil platform.
caption: Один вариант соответствующей стадии разрушения: пять ракурсов без земли, ландшафта и подписи.
prompt_override: Edit this five-view reference sheet. Keep the warm gray stone palette, pale mineral color patches, restrained olive patches, large Minecraft voxel style, and pure white background. REBUILD the entire asset as a convincingly DESTROYED much lower remnant. Every visible geometric voxel must be very large; the maximum number of stacked cubes is strict. Late destruction debris: exactly THREE separated low coarse stone chunks, heights THREE, TWO and ONE voxel blocks respectively. Loose triangular arrangement with substantial clean white gaps. No central spire, no surrounding little confetti, no fused mountain mass. Produce exactly five separate complete depictions of this SAME arrangement: front and back orthographic on upper row, left and right profiles and one isometric game view on lower row. Match the same fragment geometry and their fixed relative arrangement across all five views. No captions, labels, annotations, arrows, ground, soil, landscape, pedestal, contact shadows, ambient occlusion or cast shadows. Flat bright unlit colors; mild material tones only. Keep generous white margins. This is one asset variant, not a gallery of different rocks.
